'''Tala Squadron''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The squadron's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] included [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]]<ref name="X-Wing" /> and [[Z-95t Headhunter]]s.<ref name="CCG Tala 1" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">The ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] is set around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the events of which are dated to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the squadron's members included [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] flying the Z-95t Headhunter [[Tala 1]],<ref name="CCG Tala 1" /> alongside a [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]],<ref name="blount">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Blount}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Blount/Legends|Blount]], who flew the Z-95t Headhunter [[Tala 2]].<ref name="tala2">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Tala 2}}</ref>

Tala 1 was operationally assigned to support [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] led by [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]],<ref name="CCG Tala 1" /> an Alliance [[General/Legends|general]],<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> while its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Cracken, often flew support missions for Madine's commando team.<ref name="cracken">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Colonel Cracken}}</ref> Likewise, Tala 2 was equipped with a sophisticated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite to monitor Imperial activity during Alliance commandos' operations.<ref name="tala2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tala Squadron was created by [[Decipher]] in [[2000]], when the company's [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set introduced the Z-95t Headhunters Tala 1<ref name="CCG Tala 1" /> and Tala 2.<ref name="tala2" /> It was only in [[2014]] when the squadron's name was coined by the ''[[Z-95 Headhunter Expansion Pack]]'' for the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]'' from [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="X-Wing" />
